jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Are you looking for a new challenging role where you can have a positive impact on digital transformation journey's ?

Join Capgemini as a SAP Solution Architect, and establish a long term relationship with our major customer, helping them optimizing their SAP transformation journeys.

 

CONTEXT

• As an End to End Solution Architect within Capgemini, your role is to help our clients in crafting, modelling and delivering a working end to end solution within one or more business domains.
• As a solution architect, you are involved in all aspects of an SAP project. During the design phase, you take the lead in creating a vision and a high-level solution, as a playing field for the different functional teams. During the build phase, you closely align with the technical architects to deliver a working solution, while monitoring the functional teams so that everyone adheres to the overall vision and solution. During the prep of the Go Live and the Go Live itself, you take the lead in guiding the client towards a successful transition and a smooth start-up.
• You work in tandem with the project manager, in a joint responsibility for the success of the project in scope, timeline and budget. You provide tactical input towards the steering committee, the delivery manager and the account manager. As part of the core team for a project or customer, you are the face of Capgemini and try to defend our interests, while delivering according to client expectations.
• Your role is to drive excellence for our clients through innovative (standard) SAP solutions crafting and strategic leadership and vision, optimizing performance and processes for sustainable business success.
 

YOUR ROLE

• Solution Design: collaborate with cross-functional teams to craft, design and implement a new and effective SAP-based solution that aligns with business objectives and best practices, based on SAP’s on-premise and cloud portfolio of solutions.
• Project Leadership: work closely together with the project manager and lead the functional teams, overseeing the entire project lifecycle from a solution and delivery perspective, ensuring high quality delivery according to client expectations, but also timely and within budget.
• System Configuration: keep in touch with the system and the latest SAP solutions and toolsets, in order to support our functional teams to configure and customize SAP to meet specific organizational requirements, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and processes in or out of SAP; while sticking as close as possible to the standard of SAP
• Team Management: manage and mentor consultants of various levels of expertise; providing guidance, training, and support to enhance their skills and contribute to project success
• Internal management and contributions: As a senior colleague within Capgemini, you actively follow the latest developments, roadmaps, toolsets and strategic visions of SAP, and you actively share your findings within the Architecture Community and beyond.

YOUR PROFILE

• 10+ years of SAP project experience in a line of business, a sector or a solution suite, with proven knowledge in a SAP solution design and solution architect role
• Extensive knowledge of the latest SAP technology portfolio, on-premise, in the cloud (BTP, CALM,...) and ecosystem for your domain of expertise, and how to apply them in a clean core approach
• Knowledge of common non-SAP technologies that are used your domain of expertise, such as : GIS, Copperleaf, IoT, Field Service Management, transport management solutions, ServiceNow, integration platforms, automated warehouse management solutions, …
• A collaborative spirit & customer-oriented attitude, being able to lead both internally and externally
• Result-driven & focused on delivering quality, within the boundaries of a project and a contract
• Fluency in Dutch or French is mandatory and professional working proficiency in English

Are you looking for a new challenging role where you can have a positive impact on digital transformation journey's ? Join us today as SAP Backend Consultant.

 

YOUR ROLE

Join Capgemini as a SAP Backend Consultant and play a pivotal role in shaping the digital backbone of a client’s organization, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Core responsibilities

• Provide seamless data integration and business processes optimization, using development tools (ABAP, Java…) for creating your solutions
• Define project scopes and join forces with functional consultants to translate business requirements into technical specifications
• Create waterproof technical designs and manage project implementations
• Stay current on relevant SAP industry trends, and best practices
• 
Mentor junior team members by sharing knowledge and expertise and promote a collaborative learning culture

 

YOUR PROFILE

• A bachelor's or master's degree combined with 5+ years of SAP project experience.
• Excellent programming skills in ABAP. Other technologies like development in RAP/CAP/C4/JAVA are a plus
• Analytical problem-solving abilities to identify issues and propose innovative solutions.
• A collaborative spirit & customer-oriented attitude
• Result-driven & focused on delivering quality
• 
Fluent in Dutch or French and professional working proficiency in English

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver with On-Board Forklift (Moffett)
jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.

Talencia is looking for an Infrastructure Project Manager for one of our partner who is a company in the TOP 20 for Randstad in 2023 ! The main sector of this client is the logistic/transport.

You'll work within a multidisciplinary team supporting both the design and maintenance of high-availability IT infrastructure. This includes overseeing network, hardware, and cybersecurity architecture, as well as managing preventive and corrective maintenance in data centers and control rooms.

Your role :

• Lead end-to-end project delivery: requirements, planning, implementation, testing, and rollout.
• Manage scope, budget, timelines, quality, risk, and resources.
• Act as the link between customer expectations and internal delivery teams.
• Drive team performance and ensure value-driven results.
• Maintain documentation and ensure alignment with project governance.

Your profile :

• 5+ years' experience in project management or change management.
• Solid knowledge of IT infrastructure in high-availability environments.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
• Structured, solution-oriented, and proactive mindset.
• Fluent in Dutch or French and comfortable in English.

Are you an experienced pipe fitter who has previously worked in a pharmaceutical environment?

We are looking for an experienced pipe fitter for an ongoing project in Geel.

As a company, we are a European player specialising in complex construction projects such as data centres.

Together with your team, you will be responsible for preparing, installing and aligning stainless steel pipes used for sterile/clean processes.

In practical terms, this involves the following tasks:

• Interpreting (3D) plans and diagrams (process flows, pipes, valves, instruments, etc.)

• Installing (hygienic) stainless steel and carbon steel pipes

• Aligning pipes in preparation for the welders

• Fitting brackets, pipe racks, etc.

• Quality checks

• An eye for cleanliness and safety

Naturally, you will always adhere to the applicable procedures regarding working methods and safety.

The working language is English, so you must be proficient in this.

You must already hold a valid VCA certificate and technical competence.

In addition, you have over 5 years’ relevant experience.

Overtime occurs on a weekly basis and is generously paid at 150%.

In addition to an attractive salary in accordance with PC124, you will receive meal vouchers worth €2.59 per day worked.

Will you be joining our team?

jobs.occupation: Operations Manager | Technical Expertise Meets Leadership
jobs.description:
Lead mission-critical operations where cloud meets on-prem infrastructure—drive reliability, inspire teams, and shape the future of digital services.

Our client is a well-established technology organization operating and supporting large-scale, business-critical digital platforms.

 

The company manages a complex hybrid infrastructure environment combiningcloudandon-premises technologies, with a strong focus on operational excellence and continuous innovation.

 
Operations Manager - Tasks & Responsibilities
• Lead the day-to-day operations of Infrastructure, Operations, and Internal IT teams, ensuringservice continuity,operational excellence, and delivery of key initiatives.
• Coordinateincident management, problem resolution, escalations, and service improvement activities across production environments.
• Drive the evolution of infrastructure platforms, includingLinux systems, virtualization, containers, automation, and observability solutions.
• Manage team priorities, workloads, and stakeholder expectations while fosteringaccountability,collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Ensure operational compliance withsecurity standards, governance requirements, and infrastructure best practices.
Operations Manager - Profile
• Minimum5 years of experiencein Infrastructure Operations, IT Operations, System Engineering, or a similar technical leadership role.
• Proven experience inteam management, people leadership, coaching, and operational coordination within complex environments.
• Strong background inLinux-based infrastructures, networking, virtualization, cloud and/or on-premises environments.
• Experience withincident management, service delivery, operational governance, and continuous improvement methodologies.
• Excellentcommunication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with fluent English.

We are looking for a Network Engineer with a strong focus on Azure Cloud to help design, evolve, and operate our customers hybrid network infrastructures. You will play a key role in integrating on-premises environments with Azure in a secure, scalable, and highly available way.

In this role, you combine deep networking expertise with strong knowledge of Azure networking services, working closely with Cloud, Security, and Architecture teams. You take ownership of complex network topics and help shape a modern, cloud-ready and future-proof infrastructure.

Your days will consist of automating and maintaining the systems of our customers, as well as optimize our infrastructure and align cloud systems to serve our business goals. You’ll use your expertise in cloud platforms, automation frameworks, containerization, virtualization, networking, and security practices to drive digital transformation.

Our goal is to build reliable and cost-efficient systems. As a Network Engineer, you’ll make it happen by designing, implementing, and supporting scalable cloud environments.

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent
• At least 4 years of experience as a Network Engineer
• Proven experience of Cloud networking in hybrid network architectures (Azure, AWS)
• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and Cloud architecture principles.
• Experience implementing, monitoring and troubleshooting Azure building blocks (ExpressRoute, VPN gateways, Azure DNS,…).
• Implement and maintain network security solutions, including firewalls, network segmentation and Zero-Trust environments.
• Practice of Automation tools is an asset.
• Fluent in English, French and Dutch
Preferred Qualifications

• Relevant professional certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Network Engineer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, CCNA/CCNP.
• Experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Ansible, Terraform, ARM templates).
• 
Clear written and oral communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders
